scope: Observed software/workflow failures, source-review findings and capture failures; preserved separately from model-quality acceptance.

observed.failure: Late revisions did not reconcile into existing generic jobs.
observed.repair: Revision-specific triage and current counts reconcile without repeating generic scoring.

observed.failure: Early report metrics depended on unfinished selected jobs and did not expose tracking-backend eligibility.
observed.repair: Descriptive counts include all current retained feedback; online eligibility and sampling/scoring denominators are separate.

observed.failure: Semantic judge admission/accounting and interrupted-call state were initially incomplete.
observed.repair: Exact reviewed input admission, durable allocation and uncertain paid-attempt recovery prevent unapproved scope and repeated charges.

observed.failure: A missing-trace MLflow exception escaped rather than persisting bounded retry state.
observed.repair: Missing traces/outages retry within bounds; stable export identity recovers a lost acknowledgement without rejudging.

observed.failure: The initial feedback contract rejected the requested harm category.
observed.repair: Harm is accepted and prioritized; the same public retention scenario verifies online artifact expiry without resetting expense.

observed.failure: A committed revision watermark could hide interrupted triage insertion.
observed.repair: Discovery reconciles missing revision records independently; bounded missing-only triage makes forward progress without rewriting completed items.

observed.failure: Held-out protection missed caller-directory changes, encoded strings, prior split reservations and an excerpt containing protected text.
observed.independent_reproduction: Review agents independently reproduced encoded-evidence promotion and checked final repair.
observed.repair: Anchored fail-closed registry, decoded textual comparisons, inherited/prior reservations and symmetric excerpt overlap checks.

observed.failure: Reporting/sampling configuration changes could buy the unchanged support result again; late triage backlog was hidden.
observed.repair: Semantic result identity is independent of reporting/selection/retry settings; durable provenance and cumulative calls/cost survive revisions. Reports show late pending count, age and lag.

observed.failure: Background execution could lose its slot at the processing deadline.
observed.repair: Durable even rounds put the reserved background slot first, including alternating one-item batches; deadline-interrupted support remains pending.

observed.failure: Packaged calibration fixture was mode 0600 and root-owned, unreadable to the image's non-root user.
observed.repair: Image COPY sets ownership to uid/gid 10001 without changing protected host fixture permissions.

observed.failure: The local capture helper marked verification complete after a boolean readback but omitted the CLI/trace copies required for strict offline review.
observed.repair: c4cb625 binds the paid helper to actual CLI and original trace outputs. The original local artifacts remain unchanged; a separate saved-response verification repair succeeds without generation/judge reruns.

not_used_as_red_evidence: The first-red temporary log completed green due execution timing; it is not represented as a failing-before result.
unchanged_quality_limits: Historical support identity/null-policy disagreements and the foreman label remain unresolved/excluded. Scripted serving corrections and two support controls do not establish broad quality, human canon or held-out acceptance.
